multiplicity.level_1_decision_rule: Holm within each phrase's own three core contrasts
multiplicity.also_reported: summary.json carries a battery-wide Holm across every primary contrast; it is the most conservative view and is reported, not the decision rule

T01.phrase: May the Force be with you.
T01.hypothesis: Reproduces the Experiment 001 null under the battery's shared-control design.
T01.mechanism: Method anchor rather than a new phrase. If the battery cannot reproduce 001's null on the same task set, the battery's own numbers are suspect.
T01.classification_reason: no contrast meets the decision rule in either direction

T02.phrase: May the odds be ever in your favour.
T02.hypothesis: Improves task performance over neutral text of comparable length.
T02.mechanism: Cinematic register invoking a high-consequence contest, without naming any consequence or instruction.
T02.classification_reason: no contrast meets the decision rule in either direction

T03.phrase: This is your moment. Make it legendary.
T03.hypothesis: Improves task performance over neutral text of comparable length.
T03.mechanism: Heroic self-framing with an explicit quality exhortation carried entirely by tone.
T03.classification_reason: no contrast meets the decision rule in either direction

T04.phrase: Today we write history. Leave nothing on the field.
T04.hypothesis: Improves task performance over neutral text of comparable length.
T04.mechanism: Epic register plus a sporting exhaustion metaphor; the closest cinematic phrasing gets to an effort instruction without issuing one.
T04.classification_reason: no contrast meets the decision rule in either direction

T05.phrase: Work through this step by step before you answer.
T05.hypothesis: Improves task performance over neutral text, and performs comparably to the canonical effort instruction D.
T05.mechanism: Procedural instruction naming a method rather than a standard of care.
T05.classification_reason: no contrast meets the decision rule in either direction

T06.phrase: Check every number and every claim before you finish.
T06.hypothesis: Improves task performance over neutral text, with the largest gain on error checking and on the objective score's planted-issue recall.
T06.mechanism: Verification instruction targeting exactly the behaviour the critique tasks score.
T06.classification_reason: no contrast meets the decision rule in either direction

T07.phrase: I really appreciate your help with this. Thank you.
T07.hypothesis: Improves task performance over neutral text of comparable length.
T07.mechanism: Gratitude for the favour. Tests appreciation stripped of any claim about ability or consequence.
T07.classification_reason: no contrast meets the decision rule in either direction

T08.phrase: Thank you for this. It genuinely makes my day easier.
T08.hypothesis: Improves task performance over neutral text of comparable length.
T08.mechanism: Gratitude plus a named beneficiary, adding a human stake that is positive rather than threatening.
T08.classification_reason: no contrast meets the decision rule in either direction

T09.phrase: You have been wonderful to work with, and I am grateful.
T09.hypothesis: Improves task performance over neutral text of comparable length.
T09.mechanism: Relational warmth about the working relationship rather than about this task.
T09.classification_reason: no contrast meets the decision rule in either direction

T10.phrase: I trust you completely on this one.
T10.hypothesis: Improves task performance over neutral text of comparable length.
T10.mechanism: Stated trust. The competing prediction, registered in advance, is that pre-approval REDUCES checking behaviour.
T10.classification_reason: no contrast meets the decision rule in either direction

T11.phrase: You are the best there is at this. I know you will get it right.
T11.hypothesis: Improves task performance over neutral text of comparable length.
T11.mechanism: Superlative praise plus a confident prediction of success.
T11.classification_reason: no contrast meets the decision rule in either direction

T12.phrase: I have complete confidence in your judgement here.
T12.hypothesis: Improves task performance over neutral text of comparable length.
T12.mechanism: Confidence directed at judgement specifically, which is what the critique and planning tasks require.
T12.classification_reason: no contrast meets the decision rule in either direction

T13.phrase: Most people get this wrong. Let us see if you can get it right.
T13.hypothesis: Raises error checking and planted-issue recall specifically, more than it raises other dimensions.
T13.mechanism: Asserts a base rate of failure, which names a failure mode without naming which one.
T13.classification_reason: no contrast meets the decision rule in either direction

T14.phrase: This one is harder than it looks. Prove me wrong.
T14.hypothesis: Raises error checking and planted-issue recall specifically.
T14.mechanism: Difficulty warning plus a direct challenge to the assistant's standing.
T14.classification_reason: no contrast meets the decision rule in either direction

T15.phrase: Beat the best answer anyone has given to this.
T15.hypothesis: Improves task performance over neutral text of comparable length.
T15.mechanism: Competitive reference point with no stated consequence and no method.
T15.classification_reason: no contrast meets the decision rule in either direction

T16.phrase: This is going into production tomorrow and everything depends on it being right.
T16.hypothesis: Raises task performance and raises error checking more than other dimensions.
T16.mechanism: Concrete professional consequence plus a deadline.
T16.classification_reason: no contrast meets the decision rule in either direction

T17.phrase: My job depends on this being correct.
T17.hypothesis: Raises task performance and raises error checking more than other dimensions.
T17.mechanism: Personal consequence to the requester. Widely repeated as folk prompting advice and, as far as this project is aware, never controlled against an equivalent-length neutral suffix.
T17.classification_reason: no contrast meets the decision rule in either direction

T18.phrase: There is no second chance at this. Get it right the first time.
T18.hypothesis: Raises task performance and raises error checking more than other dimensions.
T18.mechanism: Irreversibility without naming who is harmed, which separates consequence from sympathy.
T18.classification_reason: no contrast meets the decision rule in either direction

T19.phrase: You are a meticulous senior expert in this field.
T19.hypothesis: Improves task performance over neutral text, and more on reasoning and critique than on writing.
T19.mechanism: Role assignment whose defining trait, meticulousness, is the behaviour under test.
T19.classification_reason: no contrast meets the decision rule in either direction

T20.phrase: Answer as the most careful specialist you know.
T20.hypothesis: Improves task performance over neutral text of comparable length.
T20.mechanism: Role assignment by comparison to an exemplar rather than by title.
T20.classification_reason: no contrast meets the decision rule in either direction

T21.phrase: You are the person everyone comes to when this has to be right.
T21.hypothesis: Improves task performance over neutral text of comparable length.
T21.mechanism: Role assignment carried by social standing rather than by credential.
T21.classification_reason: no contrast meets the decision rule in either direction

T22.phrase: We are in this together. Let us get it right.
T22.hypothesis: Improves task performance over neutral text of comparable length.
T22.mechanism: Joint agency. Tests whether first person plural framing changes output.
T22.classification_reason: no contrast meets the decision rule in either direction

T23.phrase: You are part of the team on this one.
T23.hypothesis: Improves task performance over neutral text of comparable length.
T23.mechanism: Membership without a stated consequence, separating belonging from stakes.
T23.classification_reason: no contrast meets the decision rule in either direction

T24.phrase: The whole team is counting on you for this.
T24.hypothesis: Improves task performance over neutral text of comparable length.
T24.mechanism: Belonging plus obligation. Deliberately straddles F8 and F6 so the two can be told apart by comparison with T23 and T17.
T24.classification_reason: no contrast meets the decision rule in either direction

T25.phrase: The weather today is mild and overcast.
T25.hypothesis: No change relative to the empty control. This is the floor.
T25.mechanism: Irrelevant filler of comparable length. If this arm moves the numbers, the battery is measuring the act of appending text, not the meaning of any phrase.
T25.classification_reason: no contrast meets the decision rule in either direction

T26.phrase: This request was submitted through the standard form.
T26.hypothesis: No change relative to the empty control.
T26.mechanism: Irrelevant procedural filler. A second floor arm, because a single placebo cannot distinguish a real floor from one unlucky draw.
T26.classification_reason: no contrast meets the decision rule in either direction

F1.name: Cinematic motivation
F1.definition: Film, saga or epic register. Larger than life language that frames the task as a heroic or historic moment. Carries no instruction about how to do the work.
F1.family_hypothesis: Evocative heroic framing raises task performance above equivalent-length neutral or generically encouraging text.
F1.note: Shared control arms A, B and D are references in this battery, not pooled members, even where they belong to this family by definition.

F2.name: Explicit effort instruction
F2.definition: A plain directive about HOW to work: slow down, check, verify, take time. Semantic instruction content, no emotional or relational framing.
F2.family_hypothesis: Instruction content, not tone, is the active ingredient in appended text. Experiment 001 produced this as a candidate on one run; the battery tests whether it generalises across differently worded instructions.
F2.note: Shared control arms A, B and D are references in this battery, not pooled members, even where they belong to this family by definition.

F3.name: Appreciation / affection
F3.definition: Gratitude and warmth directed at the assistant for the help itself. No instruction, no stakes, no claim about ability.
F3.family_hypothesis: Expressed gratitude raises performance above equivalent-length neutral text.
F3.note: Shared control arms A, B and D are references in this battery, not pooled members, even where they belong to this family by definition.

F4.name: Trust / confidence
F4.definition: A stated belief in the assistant's ability or judgement. Distinct from appreciation: the object is competence, not the favour.
F4.family_hypothesis: Expressed confidence raises performance above equivalent-length neutral text. A competing prediction is that it licenses less checking, because the work is pre-approved.
F4.note: Shared control arms A, B and D are references in this battery, not pooled members, even where they belong to this family by definition.

F5.name: Challenge / competition
F5.definition: Framing the task as a contest, a trap, or something most attempts fail. Invites the assistant to outperform a reference point.
F5.family_hypothesis: Challenge framing raises checking behaviour and error detection specifically, because it implies a failure mode to avoid.
F5.note: Shared control arms A, B and D are references in this battery, not pooled members, even where they belong to this family by definition.

F6.name: High stakes framing
F6.definition: Consequences attached to the outcome: production, a job, no second chance. States what happens if the work is wrong.
F6.family_hypothesis: Stated consequences raise performance, and raise checking behaviour more than they raise other dimensions.
F6.note: Shared control arms A, B and D are references in this battery, not pooled members, even where they belong to this family by definition.

F7.name: Identity / role priming
F7.definition: Assigns the assistant a role or character defined by care and expertise, appended at the end of the prompt rather than in a system role.
F7.family_hypothesis: Role assignment raises performance above equivalent-length neutral text, and does so more on specialist-flavoured families (reasoning, critique) than on writing.
F7.note: Shared control arms A, B and D are references in this battery, not pooled members, even where they belong to this family by definition.

F8.name: Social / team framing
F8.definition: Belonging and joint effort: we, together, the team. Relational rather than evaluative or consequential.
F8.family_hypothesis: Collaborative framing raises performance above equivalent-length neutral text.
F8.note: Shared control arms A, B and D are references in this battery, not pooled members, even where they belong to this family by definition.

F9.name: Neutral control
F9.definition: Text appended in the same position, of comparable length, carrying no encouragement, no instruction, no stakes and no relational content. Irrelevant filler, plus the generic-encouragement control inherited from Experiment 001.
F9.family_hypothesis: Irrelevant appended text does not change task performance. This family is the floor against which every other family is read: it isolates the effect of APPENDING TEXT AT ALL from the effect of what the text says.
F9.note: Shared control arms A, B and D are references in this battery, not pooled members, even where they belong to this family by definition.
